author: MidnightBeats
body:
Hello everyone.

Para (ViceWatercolour) and I have decided to make a change to the Administration system.
We have decided to remove the individual "Head of Community" and "Head of Staff" Administrator roles and instead combine those roles and work collaboratively in these departments, alongside the other Senior Staff members.

In other words, each Administrator, that would be Para and I, will no longer be given the titles of "Community Admin" and "Staff Admin," respectively, but instead work together in these areas.

Do you like this change? Please let us know below.

Regards,
The Administration Team
